meta.title: For Ruhi
meta.from: A friend who genuinely wants to meet you

node.note: optional smaller line under the body

start.body:
Ruhi… it has been more than 1.5 year, we know each other.
Aur itne time mein I have asked you many times to meet you, and you only agreed once! And I have always respected your will (Just as I will this time too). I am not going to ask for very big gesture or having any expectations.
Just a simple genuine request.. Mujhe tumse milne ka bahut man hai..
start.note: Jo bhi jawab ho, main uski respect karunga.

options.label: thik h, milte hain
options.sublabel: ab ek pair pe khade ho jaoge toh kya hi karun

options.label: Not sure, mujhe dar h bahut
options.sublabel: Aap nai samjhoge mere man ki baat

meeting-options.body:
Can't Believe this!! Finally a Yes. 
Thankyou, and I promise, you will never feel ki, tumne koi galti ki. 

And tum jaisa kaho, we can do that.. Jaise tumhe best lage
meeting-options.note: Few suggestions jo tumhe bhi acche lagenge..

options.label: Koibhi Tumhari favourite place + favourite snacks
options.sublabel: Aaram se baith k, gi-bhar k daat lena, mai sab sununga

options.label: Movie, if you want to avoid getting seen
options.sublabel: Anyone can sit next to you in a movie… why not me this time?

options.label: Park mein walk
options.sublabel: Simple walk, thodi hawa, thodi baatein

options.label: Treasure Island Mall
options.sublabel: Ghoom lenge, kuch kha lenge, a lot can happen in a mall

options.label: Main batayungi, vaisa karten h.. thik
options.sublabel: Mai jaisa bolungi, chup chaap manni padegi

options.label: Ab soch rahi hun toh, sahi nai lag raha
options.sublabel: Mujhe nai lagta ki aa payungi

favourite-place.body:
Honestly, meri favourite choice toh yehi hai.

Tumhari favourite jagah, tumhare favourite snacks, bas normally baithkar baat kareinge jaisa hamesha karten h. No awkward planning, no pressure.

Aur agar tumhe comfortable lage toh main tumhe pick kar lunga. Ya tum cab se aa sakti ho — jo tumhe better lage.
favourite-place.note: After all this time I just want to see you, bas..

movie.body:
Tumne kahan tha na, 'Kiske saath jayun yaar'.. 😄

Tum confirm karo, toh main book karta hun. 😌

Aur agar concern ye hai ki koi mujhe dekh lega, toh simple — tum cab se aa jaana, main wahaan mil jaunga. No unnecessary attention.
movie.note: its not my first choice, but if you are comfortable, then movie it is.

options.label: Okay, movie karte hain
options.sublabel: But Aap lene aa sakten ho

options.label: Movie nahi, kuch simple karte hain

walk.body:
Walk bhi perfect hai.

Koi nearby park, thodi walk, thodi baatein… nothing complicated.

Jo option tumhe less stressful lage.
walk.note: No fixed activity to do. Bas thoda sa time sath baaten.

other-plan.body:
Nearby mall chalein, kuch kha lein, coffee, thoda shopping, ya literally jo tum suggest karo.

Mujhe activity se zyada tumhare saath thoda time spend karna hai.
other-plan.note: Tum comfortable ho, bas wahi important hai.

other-activity.body: Jo tumhe sahi lage, woh bata do. Main uske around sochunga — tumhari marzi pehle.
other-activity.note: Khali bhi chhod sakti ho, sirf milna kaafi hai.

fear.body:
I understand. Agar dar ye hai ki koi humein saath dekh lega ya unnecessary questions honge, toh we can keep it very simple, quite, and private. I don't want to stress you out. I just want to make it easier for you. 
Iske alawa, agar koi baat hai toh please batao.. I will manage things for you. 
But, please ek baar socho toh
fear.note: Agar phir bhi uncomfortable ho, you can still say NO.

options.label: Thik hai chalo, aati hun milne
options.sublabel: but koi taam jhaam nahi hoga

options.label: Koi quiet jagah choose karte hain

yes-confirm.body:
Dekhna, tumhe milke accha hi lagega. Aur shayad milne ke baad tum khud sochogi ki tum befizul dar rahi thi.

I won't make it awkward, I won't expect anything from you. Bas genuinely thoda time spend karenge, baat karenge, aur phir apne-apne ghar.

Thank you finally han kehne k liye..
yes-confirm.note: Baaki plan hum saath mein decide karten hai. I'll msg you

first-no.body:
Okay… I hear you.

Bas ek last baar mein tumse ye kehna chahata hun.. Kash mein samaj pata ki tumhe kaise manayun?
Ruhi, no-one knows the future, kal ye time, ye chance ho na ho.. Aakhir zindagi ka kya bharosa. Aur kismat toh kabhi nahi chahati ki hamari baat bhi ho, isslye I rely on efforts than luck.. 

 and I am ready to put this much efforts just to spend some time with you, it shows how much you are important to me. 

And all I want is to spend some time with you.. thats it!, nothing more - nothing less, no expectation
first-no.note: I'm asking one last time, not trying to pressure you.

options.label: Dar h mujhe bht… but maybe
Theek hai, sirf ek baar mil leti hoon
Nahi, I really don't want to

ui.placeholder: Anything if you want to say

final-no.body:
Theek hai, Ruhi. I understand.

I didn't wanted to giveup before trying my best. But still if your answer is No, then I will respect it.

No guilt, no anger, no more convincing. Tum comfortable raho, khush ho — that's more important than me getting what I want.

And thank you for listening me.
final-no.note: I won't ask again. I promise.

end.body: This is the End of the request, please close the page
